schemas.name: read

schemas.name: apply_patch
schemas.description: Apply a patch to project files. `patchText` must start with `*** Begin Patch` and end with `*** End Patch`. For `*** Add File: <relative path>`, prefix every content line with `+`; no content lines creates an empty file. Update hunks use `*** Update File: <relative path>`, optionally immediately followed by `*** Move to: <relative path>`, then `@@` and lines where context starts with a space, removals with `-`, additions with `+`, all matching file bytes exactly. Delete uses `*** Delete File: <relative path>`. Paths stay inside the project root.

schemas.name: subagent
schemas.description:
Spawns an agent in a child session to work on the specified task.
The output includes a sessionID you can pass back later to continue that specific conversation with the subagent.
New child sessions start with fresh context, so include all relevant context and instructions when you don't pass a sessionID.
Foreground (default) runs the subagent to completion and returns its final response.

Available subagents:
- vis36-child: Isolated VIS36 child; follow the supplied task.

agent.description: The type of specialized agent to use for this task.

description.description: A short 3-5 word label for the task, displayed to the user

prompt.description: The task for the subagent to perform

model.description: NEVER set this unless the user explicitly asks for a particular model or variant. The value is written as "providerID/modelID", or "providerID/modelID#variant" to include a variant. Do not guess the ID.

sessionID.description: Continue a specific previous subagent conversation by passing its sessionID. Calls without a sessionID start a new conversation.

background.description: Not supported yet: calls with true fail without creating a child session.

schemas.name: read
schemas.description: Read a project file slice. `path` is relative to the project root; `offset` is the 1-based first line, `limit` caps lines (default 50).

schemas.name: glob
schemas.description: List project paths matching a bounded glob. Results are sorted and paginated.

schemas.name: grep
schemas.description: Search project text with a bounded literal pattern. Results are sorted and paginated; regex mode is unsupported.

schemas.name: apply_patch
schemas.description: Apply a patch to project files. `patchText` must start with `*** Begin Patch` and end with `*** End Patch`. For `*** Add File: <relative path>`, prefix every content line with `+`; no content lines creates an empty file. Update hunks use `*** Update File: <relative path>`, optionally immediately followed by `*** Move to: <relative path>`, then `@@` and lines where context starts with a space, removals with `-`, additions with `+`, all matching file bytes exactly. schemas.name: apply_patch
schemas.description: Apply a patch to project files. `patchText` must start with `*** Begin Patch` and end with `*** End Patch`. For `*** Add File: <relative path>`, prefix every content line with `+`; no content lines creates an empty file. Update hunks use `*** Update File: <relative path>`, optionally immediately followed by `*** Move to: <relative path>`, then `@@` and lines where context starts with a space, removals with `-`, additions with `+`, all matching file bytes exactly. Delete uses `*** Delete File: <relative path>`. Paths stay inside the project root.

schemas.name: bash

schemas.name: compress

schemas.name: subagent
schemas.description:
Spawns an agent in a child session to work on the specified task.
The output includes a sessionID you can pass back later to continue that specific conversation with the subagent.
New child sessions start with fresh context, so include all relevant context and instructions when you don't pass a sessionID.
Foreground (default) runs the subagent to completion and returns its final response.

Available subagents:
- vis36-child: Isolated VIS36 child; follow the supplied task.

agent.description: The type of specialized agent to use for this task.

description.description: A short 3-5 word label for the task, displayed to the user

prompt.description: The task for the subagent to perform

model.description: NEVER set this unless the user explicitly asks for a particular model or variant. The value is written as "providerID/modelID", or "providerID/modelID#variant" to include a variant. Do not guess the ID.

sessionID.description: Continue a specific previous subagent conversation by passing its sessionID. Calls without a sessionID start a new conversation.

background.description: Not supported yet: calls with true fail without creating a child session.
